description: This file defines the 'Frame' class for managing browser frames in the Playwright automation library, including navigation, element interaction, and event handling.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a browser frame, providing methods for navigation, element interaction, and event handling within that frame.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to get a Frame instance from a channel object.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Static method to get a Frame instance from a channel object or null.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Frame instance, setting up event listeners for load states and navigation.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the Page object associated with this frame.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the frame to a specified URL.

methods.name: waitForNavigation
methods.description: Waits for the frame to navigate to a new URL.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the frame to reach a specified load state.

methods.name: waitForURL
methods.description: Waits until the frame's URL matches a given pattern.

methods.name: frameElement
methods.description: Returns the element handle for the frame element.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the frame context and returns a handle.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the frame context and returns the result.

methods.name: _evaluateFunction
methods.description: Internal method to evaluate a function in the frame context.

methods.name: _evaluateExposeUtilityScript
methods.description: Internal method to evaluate a utility script in the frame context.
Queries for an element matching the selector.

methods.name: waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for an element matching the selector to appear.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event on an element.

methods.name: $eval
methods.description: Evaluates a function on an element matching the selector.

methods.name: $$eval
methods.description: Evaluates a function on all elements matching the selector.
Returns all elements matching the selector.

methods.name: _queryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of elements matching the selector.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Returns the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the frame.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the frame.

methods.name: parentFrame
methods.description: Returns the parent frame, if any.

methods.name: childFrames
methods.description: Returns the child frames.

methods.name: isDetached
methods.description: Checks if the frame is detached.

methods.name: addScriptTag
methods.description: Adds a script tag to the frame.

methods.name: addStyleTag
methods.description: Adds a style tag to the frame.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks an element matching the selector.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Double-clicks an element.

methods.name: dragAndDrop
methods.description: Performs a drag and drop operation.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on an element.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element.

methods.name: _highlight
methods.description: Highlights an element.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Creates a Locator object for the selector.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Returns a Locator for an element with a specific test ID.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Returns a Locator for an element with specific alt text.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Returns a Locator for an element with specific label text.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a Locator for an element with specific placeholder text.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Returns a Locator for an element with specific text content.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Returns a Locator for an element with specific title.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Returns a Locator for an element with a specific role.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a FrameLocator for nested frames.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses an element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Gets the text content of an element.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Gets the inner text of an element.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Gets the inner HTML of an element.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Gets an attribute value of an element.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Gets the value of an input element.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if a checkbox or radio is checked.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if an element is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if an element is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if an element is enabled.
